title: Settings
subline: Manage your data and application settings

storageNote.title: Data storage
storageNote.body: Your data is saved in this browser. Clearing the browser data deletes it unless Cloud sync keeps a copy. Export a backup from time to time.

export.title: Export Data
export.description: Download a backup file of all your saved playthroughs.

reset.title: Reset All Data
reset.warning: This deletes every playthrough on this device. You can undo it for 10 seconds afterwards.
reset.syncedCopy: Also delete the synced copy in {provider}
reset.syncedOn: Sync stays on. Your other devices lose these playthroughs at their next sync. Export a backup first if you are not sure.
reset.doneMessage: {count, plural, one {{amount} playthrough} other {{amount} playthroughs}} deleted.
reset.doneMessageDisconnected: {count, plural, one {{amount} playthrough} other {{amount} playthroughs}} deleted. Sync is disconnected on this browser.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how the app looks. The choice is saved on this device only and is not part of a backup.
appearance.themeNote: System follows your device, which uses the {mode, select, dark {dark} other {light}} theme right now.

playthroughs.title: Playthroughs
playthroughs.description: Create, switch, edit and delete playthroughs on the Playthroughs page.

about.summary: A progress tracking tool for Supermarket Simulator. Your data is saved in this browser, or in your own cloud storage if you turn on sync.
about.disclaimer: Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Supermarket Simulator or its developers. All trademarks and game content belong to their owners.

importDialog.title: Import a backup
importDialog.checks: {count, plural, one {{amount} entry} other {{amount} entries}} read, {kept} with an id and a name.
importDialog.howToApply: How should the file be applied?

modeNotes.merge: Adds playthroughs that are new. For a playthrough on both, the copy updated last wins. Playthroughs only on this device stay. Your active playthrough stays active.
modeNotes.replace: Deletes the playthroughs on this device and keeps only the file. The file's active playthrough becomes active.

importDialog.undoNote: You can undo the import for 10 seconds afterwards.
importDialog.skipped: {count, plural, one {{amount} entry} other {{amount} entries}} skipped.
importDialog.levelsFixed: {count, plural, one {{amount} store level} other {{amount} store levels}} below 0 will be saved as 0.

errors.notJson: This file is not a Supermarket Simulator Buddy backup: it is not valid JSON. Nothing was changed.
errors.playthroughsMissing: This file is not a Supermarket Simulator Buddy backup: the playthroughs list is missing. Nothing was changed.

region.title: Language and region
region.description: How text, numbers and dates show on this device. Saved on this device only.

language.label: Language
language.hint: Game names such as products, licenses and tools stay in English.
